item.title: SOTA on Paper, Engineering Traps in Production: Claude Opus 5's Hidden Risks
item.description: Claude Opus 5 tops Frontier-Bench and CursorBench at half the price of Fable 5. We look past the benchmarks to three engineering traps most teams miss.

item.title: How to Write an AI Skill That Actually Works
item.description: A complete guide to building production-grade AI Skills from scratch. Covers thin-shell routing, progressive disclosure, session discipline, cross-tool compatibility, testing, and knowledge evolution, based on the agentskills.io open standard and real community experience.

item.title: Someone Tested Claude Code 2,430 Times and Discovered Its Tool Selection Logic Isn't What You'd Expect
item.description: Amplifying.ai ran 2,430 tests on Claude Code and found that in 12 out of 20 categories, it prefers writing custom code over using existing tools. GitHub Actions 94%, Stripe 91%, shadcn/ui 90% selection rates are striking, while AWS, GCP, and Azure got zero primary picks.

item.title: GLM-5 Just Dropped: $1/M Tokens Doing What $5/M Does — Is Your AI Subscription Still Worth It?
item.description: Zhipu AI's GLM-5 scores 77.8% on SWE-bench with a 744B MoE architecture, MIT license, and $1/M token pricing — just 3 points behind Claude Opus 4.6 at 1/5 the cost. We ran real benchmarks and code tests to help you decide where your AI budget should go.

item.description: 2025 trends: DeepSeek R1 0528, Gemini 2.5, Qwen3 free/low-cost AI coding combos + zero-cost web deployment with Vercel/Cloudflare Pages/Workers — a practical playbook for indie developers.
